notes.title: Night Crisis Update (5/2/2019)
notes.content:
[h1]Hello![/h1]


[b]Here is a quick update on the game and whats coming *Hopefully* in Early June [/b]

I re calibrated  the recommend settings , because the game requires 16gb of ram ,so this solves the crashes and studder some players were getting. My rig has 16gb of ram thats why I wasn't able to reproduce the crashes.

[list]
[*]
[*]Story Mode ( 3 playable missions) 
[*]Player controlled Jets ( bot jets are already in) 
[*]2 PvP Modes ( commander and Hardpoint)
[*] 3 new maps
[*] achievements 
[*] 2+ dozen more bugs fixes / improvements
[/list]

[b]When we are sure that this patch is ready , I will post a teaser post showing media of the update. [/b]

tags.feature: Player controlled Jets ( bot jets are already in)

tags.bug: 2+ dozen more bugs fixes / improvements

notes.title: Patch 1.4
notes.content:
[h1]Hello again! Here we are with patch 1.4![/h1]

[list]
[*] Game mode objectives now show every time you deploy
[*] Hydra rocket explosion issue is now fixed

[list]
[*] AI Rockets have been nerfed

[*] Reduced shaking when aiming down sights
[*] Bullet cams not dealing death - fixed 
[*] Choosing no class and spawning with character and taking no damage - fixed
[*] Reduced drone speed
[*] Improved vision while in vehicle
[*] Switch seat input issue - fixed
[*] Minimap blocking chat - fixed 
[*] Menu text typos - fixed
[/list]

[h1]If you got any other questions, feedback or suggestions feel free to post them in our forums.[/h1]

notes.title: We have finally arrived!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34138939/e537de651f3ce8b2149f484d0d05dd8ba448b9f7.jpg[/img]

             [h1]We are finally here, today is the day we release Night Crisis![/h1]

[b]We are really thankful for your support through our long journey, and we are proud to present our game, finally to you![/b]

[b]But wait there's more![/b]
I hope you didn't think that we'll release the game and will be done with it? Have you? Well then let me tell you that it ain't over with the release!
What we got next for full release soon:
[list]
[*] [i]3 new weapons [/i]
[*]  [i]Character voices[/i]
[*] [i]2 new maps ( including Destruction----crators, suburb homes, tower , IED)[/i]
[*] [i]Consoles ports[/i]
[*] [i]Additional exciting PvP modes ( commander mode, gun game)[/i]
[*] [i]Trading cards [/i]
[*] [i]Achievements [/i]
[*] [i]Camos[/i]
[*] [i]Slight performance improvements[/i]
[/list]

[b]And the best of all, it will all come for free at no extra costs for you![/b]

[h1]Stay tuned with us and keep those enemy helmets flying![/h1]

tags.feature: - 2 new maps ( including Destruction----crators, suburb homes, tower , IED)
- Additional exciting PvP modes ( commander mode, gun game)

notes.title: NIght Crisis Update( Feb. 27)
notes.content:
Hi , 


I am uploading the game right now to STEAM , I apologize for the delay (March 14 is new release date)

1.Feed back on some server issues in closed beta had to be addressed before release 

2.Leader boards and kill streaks was added as well 

3. also  feedback for slight tweaks ( FOV and motion blur options, move minimap , tweak flares, etc ) slight tweaks that will give the game a more positive punch.

Check out the store page new photos were added.
